title: Harness the Power of North Carolina Solar Incentives with Duke Energy
excerpt: Discover the benefits of installing solar panels in North Carolina with Duke Energy's solar incentives for homeowners.
content:
What are North Carolina Solar Incentives?

North Carolina solar incentives are programs designed to encourage homeowners to switch to renewable energy sources, such as solar power. These incentives can help reduce the upfront costs of installing solar panels and increase the return on investment.

Duke Energy's Solar Incentives in North Carolina

Duke Energy offers various solar incentives for homeowners in North Carolina, including the Solar Buyback Program and the Residential Energy Loan Program. The Solar Buyback Program allows homeowners to sell excess energy back to Duke Energy, while the Residential Energy Loan Program provides low-interest loans for energy-efficient upgrades, including solar panel installations.

How to Take Advantage of Duke Energy's Solar Incentives

To take advantage of Duke Energy's solar incentives, homeowners must meet certain eligibility requirements. This includes owning the property, having a qualifying solar panel system, and meeting Duke Energy's net metering requirements. Homeowners can visit the Duke Energy website to learn more about eligibility requirements and to apply for the Solar Buyback Program.

Conclusion

North Carolina solar incentives can help homeowners save money on their energy bills and reduce their carbon footprint. Duke Energy's solar incentives, including the Solar Buyback Program and the Residential Energy Loan Program, make it easier and more affordable to switch to renewable energy sources.
